target.name: help
target.description: List main Ant tasks (curated; ant -p dumps every described target).
target.echo:
Main jAER Ant tasks ant help (this list) ant -p every target that has a description Default with no args: ant same as ant jar
Everyday (git checkout) check-jdk fail if this JVM is older than JDK 25; print Adoptium install URL compile Ivy retrieve + javac. First-time / after ivy.xml changes. Needs JDK 25+. run compile, then launch JAERViewer. Needs JDK 25+. compile-fast javac only (lib/ already filled by compile or download-deps). jar compile + dist/jAER.jar jar-fast compile-fast + store-only dist/jAER.jar (optional 7z sidecar) replace-installed-jar copy dist/jAER.jar onto the install4j install (Windows UAC). Example: ant jar-fast replace-installed-jar Override: -Djaer.install.dir=C:\Program Files\jAER install launch the current-OS installer from currentInstallers/VERSION/ Does not compile media. Build first: ant install4j (or ant release) install-jaer-run-shortcut once per computer: Ctrl+F5 in Cursor runs jAER: ant run VS Code too: -Djaer.shortcut.editor=both clean delete build/ products (not lib/) javadoc build Javadoc test unit tests
Dependencies (Ivy) download-deps resolve/retrieve jars into lib/ clean-deps delete lib/ clean-ivy clean-deps clean-ivy-cache delete ivy/ cache (next compile re-downloads)
macOS install-macos-libusb Homebrew libusb on Apple Silicon (also runs from ant run). Skip: -Dskip.macos.libusb=true
Releases See docs/README-releasing-tagging.md. Local ant release is unsigned. Windows Authenticode is GitHub Actions + SignPath (not a local Ant sign). release confirm VERSION.txt, splash, clean/jar, then install4jc release-windows-ci Windows-only media, no confirm (used by GitHub Actions) signpath-ci trigger GitHub SignPath workflow (needs gh; push first). Policy: -Dsignpath.policy=test-signing2|release-signing install4j install4jc only (needs dist/jAER.jar + build/opencv-slim) Local: compression 5 + --faster (no LZMA). Release stays 9+LZMA. Override: -Djaer.install4j.compression=7 -Djaer.install4j.faster=false generate-splash VERSION.txt overlay on splash PNGs (1024/256 icons, 800 splash) copy-updates-xml currentInstallers/<version>/updates.xml -> repo root upload-release-notes GitHub Release body from release-notes/ (needs gh) count-asset-downloads GitHub Release asset download counts (needs gh auth) One tag: -Djaer.asset.downloads.tag=3.3.0 More rows: -Djaer.asset.downloads.limit=20 All files: -Djaer.asset.downloads.all=true split-opencv-natives per-OS slim OpenCV jars for install4j pack-sample-data zip sampleData recordings, write SIZE.txt (skips if zip+name/size stamp match) jaer-runtime-archive zip a runtime tree (legacy; prefer install4j)
Scripts (not Ant) scripts/run-jaer-fast.bat|.sh launch from build/classes without ant

target.name: check-jdk
target.description: Require JDK 25+ (Adoptium Temurin) for compile and run.
target.fail:
This JVM is ${java.version} (java.home=${java.home}). jAER compiles to Java 25 bytecode and needs JDK 25+ to compile and to run from git (ant compile / ant run).
Install Eclipse Temurin 25 (LTS) from https://adoptium.net/ Windows: https://adoptium.net/temurin/releases/?os=windows&package=jdk&version=25 or winget install EclipseAdoptium.Temurin.25.JDK macOS: https://adoptium.net/temurin/releases/?os=mac&package=jdk&version=25 or brew install --cask temurin@25 Linux: https://adoptium.net/temurin/releases/?os=linux&package=jdk&version=25
Then put that JDK on PATH and set JAVA_HOME to it. Confirm with: java -version Ant uses the same JVM as java. Restart the terminal (and IDE) after changing JAVA_HOME.
